goal: Stop block and header validation checks from returning conflicting status flags and error states
Prevent chained validation steps from inheriting or overwriting unrelated failure reasons
agreement: Broad concept support for removing mutable validation out-parameters
Contested objection that relying on asserts over compile-time types risks runtime aborts (hodlinator)
Verified that updates change signatures without altering behavior (arejula27)
Support because returning values directly instead of using out-parameters is cleaner (purpleKarrot)

categories.name: validation
why: P3 because it eliminates an interface hazard where validation results and error states can disagree
It improves long-term validation safety but fixes no active bug and carries no direct user impact
